dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Honestly? Much better. I really owe you one back there. I was so cold I couldn't even walk. Without your help, I'd probably be frozen stiff like some ice sculpture by now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Oh, right. These Glaciafruit are a specialty my family just sent over. Fresh as can be! Consider them my thanks for saving my life.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Hehe, a rough fellow like me doesn't have anything valuable to offer, so I hope you won't mind, my friend!
